decision_reason: Patch 080 preserves the bounded private role/property, text-relocation, RPATH, and RUNPATH facts, corrects the Patch 079 evidence and custody blockers, and adds a private candidate-indexed register-role side-car. The corrected task-value gate supports only private additive role facets. Fresh native/Docker acceptance, qualified parity, public-consumer compatibility, and an explicit public-value gate remain open, so no public PIE/DSO, IBT, SHSTK, text-relocation, RPATH, RUNPATH, or register-role projection is authorized.
